propositions: The loud refusal in _pai_check_config blocks valid base_url and api_key configuration despite documentation and existing config parsing support
An openai provider builder must be registered conditionally (only when base_url is set) to preserve lazy model-string resolution for bare openai:model cases and keep the SDK optional

The provider must override model_profile to withdraw supports_json_schema_output=False for custom endpoints while preserving other capabilities, because base_url points to an incompatible server not the hosted OpenAI API
base_url must remain provider configuration, not provider selection—REBAR_LLM_MODEL_PROVIDER still controls which provider is used
Validation must replace the refusal to allow absolute URLs with proper base_url, reject api_key without base_url, and error clearly on missing openai SDK
